input.question: Why is China buying so many companies around the world?
input.ground_truth: The Chinese government is not buying 'so many' companies around the world. Rich Chinese people are buying companies around the world for the same reason rich people of any nation do - because it's a great way to make even more money, and to diversify your wealth.

Explain the following question in a simple way as if you are explaining to a 5-year-old.

Question: Why is China buying so many companies around the world?

Answer:

response.prediction:
Okay! Imagine you really, really like toy blocks. You want to have lots and lots of different kinds of blocks to build the biggest and coolest castles and towers. So, you start buying blocks from your friends and from other kids in different neighborhoods. That way, you have more blocks and can build even better things.

China is kind of like that, but instead of toy blocks, they want things like big companies that make phones, cars, or food. When China buys these companies, they get to use their ideas and make more things. They want to have lots of different companies so they can be strong in the world and help their people have nice things too.
